projectTitle: Trillium Brewing: A Shopify store for more than one taproom
project_haiku: Trillium grew from a Fort Point taproom in 2013 to several locations and a wide list of beers. We built the Shopify store that sells the beer and points people at the right room.
project_footer_CTA: Selling from more than one location, with more than one way to order? Trillium's store had to do that.
pageSummary:
The job

JC and Esther Tetreault opened Trillium in Fort Point in 2013. The company grew to hundreds of people, more taprooms, a production brewery in Canton, and a farm in North Stonington. The site had to sell beer, explain the locations, and carry more than one way to order.

What we built

The store is Shopify. Product pages cover the range, from New England IPAs to mixed-fermentation beers and the other drinks. Location content covers Fort Point, Fenway, the Greenway beer garden, Canton, and the farm. Ordering is part of the same site as the story of the beer.

Outcomes

A customer can find a beer and a taproom. Trillium can add a release without a separate microsite for every one.
